visual_identity.color_palette: Muted swamp-brown and moss-grey shaggy feathers; bright 'sun-bleached' yellow on the beak and around the eyes.
visual_identity.texture: Thick, shaggy, 'wet' feather texture; leathery, wrinkled skin on the legs and belly; smooth keratinous beak.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Massive 2.4-meter arms with three enormous curved claws; a prominent, high muscular hump on the back.

anatomy_constraints.head: Duck-billed, toothless snout; small eyes set high on the head; deep lower jaw.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Gigantic forelimbs with heavy claws; stout, thick hind legs with blunt, hoof-like toes.
anatomy_constraints.body: Large, bulky, pot-bellied torso; tall neural spines forming a distinct ridge over the back.

visual_logic.subject: A massive, gentle Deinocheirus wading through a shallow lake.
visual_logic.action: Using its wide beak to sift through floating aquatic plants while its massive arms hang ready.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the Nemegt formation palette of dark organic mud and deep greens, with large conifers and water lilies.

personality: The 'Bizarre Giant'—unusual, slow-moving, and strangely majestic. He has a calm, cow-like temperament but is formidable if cornered.
